Having the best camera has long required buying Apple's largest iPhone Pro model. Most reports to date indicate that the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will have identical camera specifications, but a leaker has questioned that claim.

Specifically, they point out that two new features originally expected to debut on both Pro models may instead become exclusive to the Pro Max...

The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max share identical camera specifications, with all three rear lenses using 48-megapixel sensors. Apple says the telephoto lens offers up to 8x optical zoom, but in practice this is achieved by cropping a 24-megapixel image, so it is more accurate to say it offers 4x optical zoom with an 8x cropped option.

Current consensus suggests both Pro models this year will continue to share the same camera features, including a variable aperture main lens and a telephoto lens with a wider aperture for improved low-light performance.

However, leaker Ice Universe says two new telephoto lens features may be limited to the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

If true, this would mean that to get the longest telephoto reach and the best low-light performance, you would have to buy the Pro Max. However, the leaker used the word "may," indicating they are not fully certain, perhaps because they have seen conflicting evidence within Apple's supply chain.

Other reports have suggested that the variable aperture system on the main lens may also be a Pro Max exclusive, but reports vary.

If you have always preferred the smaller of the two Pro models, would you switch to the Pro Max for better camera capabilities? Let us know in the comments.
